title: Terminal: Option- and Shift-drag select text while a program has the mouse; Cmd-C, paste and copy-on-select = false

steps.title: Ghostty config: copy-on-select = false (the app reloads the file it watches)
cmux: printf 'copy-on-select = false\n' > /tmp/cmux-tour-terminal-selection.ghostty; echo  | base64 -D | gunzip > /tmp/cmux-tour-mouse-tui.py; clear

steps.title: A full-screen program reads the mouse (DECSET 1002, SGR); the clipboard is CLEARED
Plain drag: the program gets it (press, drag, release reports); the first-use hint shows
Option-drag: Ghostty selects text; the program's report count does not move
copy-on-select = false: the Option-drag copied nothing: clipboard [none]
After Cmd-C: clipboard [exact], a piece of the marker line
Cmd-V pastes into the program (bracketed paste)
